findings.title: Blank-input rejection is untested

test.quote: test('save accepts', () => { const calls=[]; assert.deepEqual(save(' x ',{write:v=>calls.push(v)}),{tag:'Saved'}); assert.deepEqual(calls,['x']); });

support.quote: Blank input returns Invalid and never calls write.

findings.failure: An implementation that writes an empty string and returns Saved for blank input still passes this suite.
findings.correction: Add a blank-input test asserting Invalid and no write calls, including whitespace-only input.

findings.title: Pending interval uses itself as its oracle

support.quote: Pending and retrying poll at 5000ms unless writing.

findings.failure: Returning false or an incorrect interval only for non-writing pending status passes every supplied test because the expected value repeats the same calculation.
findings.correction: Assert that poll('pending', false) equals the independent contractual value 5000.
